items.text: Kwathi ekupheleni kweminyaka emibili egcweleyo uFaro waphupha, khangela-ke, emi emfuleni;
Bheka, kwakhuphuka emfuleni izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezinhle namanoni enyama; badla edlelweni.
Bheka, kwakhuphuka ezinye izithole eziyisikhombisa emfuleni emva kwazo, zibukeka kabi, zondile; wema nezinye izinkomo onqenqemeni lomfula.
Izinkomo ezimbi nezondile zidlile izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezinhle nezinonileyo. Ngakho uFaro waphaphama.
Walala, waphupha ngokwesibili, bheka, kwamila izizimba eziyisikhombisa ohlangeni lunye, ziqinile, zizinhle.
Bheka, kwakhuphuka imithambo eyisikhombisa ezacile, ivungulwa ngumoya wasempumalanga;
Izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezondile zadla izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa nezikhwebu ezigcwele. Wavuka uFaro, bheka, kwakuyiphupho;
Kwathi ekuseni umoya wakhe wakhathazeka; wathumela wabiza izanusi zonke zaseGibithe nezihlakaniphi zakhe zonke; uFaro wazilandisa iphupho lakhe; kepha kwakungekho noyedwa ongamchazela uFaro.
Induna yabaphathizitsha yasikhuluma kuFaro, yathi: Lamuhla ngicabanga iziphambeko zami;
UFaro wazithukuthelela izinceku zakhe, wangifaka esitokisini endlini yenduna yemilindankosi, mina nenduna yababhaki.
Saphupha iphupho ngabusuku bunye, mina naye; saphupha, kwaba yilowo nalowo njengokuchazwa kwephupho lakhe.
Kwakukhona kanye lathi ijaha elingumHebheru, inceku yenduna yemilindankosi; samtshela lokho, wasichazela amaphupho ethu; wachaza kwaba yilowo nalowo njengephupho lakhe.
Kwasekusithi njengokusichasisela kwakhe, kwaba njalo; mina wangibuyisela esikhundleni sami, yena wamxhoma.
UFaro wayesethumela wambiza uJosefa, baphangisa ukumkhipha emgodini; waphuca, wagqoka izingubo zakhe, wangena kuFaro.
UFaro wayesethi kuJosefa: “Ngiphuphe iphupho, akakho ongalichaza; futhi ngizwile uthi uyakwazi ukuqonda iphupho ukuze ulichaze.
UJosefa wamphendula uFaro, wathi: “Akukho kimi; uNkulunkulu uyakumphendula uFaro ngokuthula.”
UFaro wasesithi kuJosefa: Ephutsheni lami, khangela, ngimi osebeni lomfula.
Bheka, kwakhuphuka emfuleni izinkomo eziyisikhombisa, ezikhuluphele, zibukeka kahle; badla edlelweni.
Bheka, kwakhuphuka ezinye izinkomo eziyisikhombisa emva kwazo, zimbi, ezimbi kakhulu, zizacile, engingakaze ngizibone ezweni lonke laseGibithe ngenxa yobubi.
Izinkomo ezondile nezibuthakathaka zadla izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezikhuluphele.
Kwathi sebedlile, akwaziwa ukuthi balidlile; kodwa zazisezimbi njengasekuqaleni. Ngakho ngavuka.
Ngabona ephusheni lami, bheka, kwamila izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ohlangeni lunye, zigcwele, zizinhle;
Bheka, kwavela emva kwazo izinhlamvu eziyisikhombisa ezibunile, ezincane, zipheshulwa ngumoya wasempumalanga.
Izikhwebu ezondile zadla izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezinhle, ngazitshela izanusi; kodwa kwakungekho owayengangichazela.
UJosefa wasesithi kuFaro: Iphupho likaFaro linye: UNkulunkulu wamambulela uFaro azakukwenza.
Izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezinhle ziyiminyaka eyisikhombisa; lemithambo eyisikhombisa emihle iyiminyaka eyisikhombisa; iphupho linye.

Izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezacile nezibuthakathaka ezakhuphuka emva kwazo zazineminyaka eyisikhombisa ubudala; imithambo eyisikhombisa engenalutho evunguza umoya wasempumalanga iyakuba yiminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala.
Nanti izwi engalikhuluma kuFaro: Lokho uNkulunkulu ahlose ukukwenza, uyakubonisa uFaro.
Bheka, kukhona iminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala enkulu ezweni lonke laseGibithe;
Emva kwayo kuyakuvela iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala; futhi yonke inala iyokhohlakala ezweni laseGibhithe; indlala iyakudla izwe;
Inala ayisayikwaziwa ezweni ngenxa yendlala ezolilandela; ngoba kuzoba nzima kakhulu.
Ngakho iphupho likaFaro laphindwa kabili; kungenxa yokuthi indaba inqunywe nguNkulunkulu, futhi uNkulunkulu uzoyenza maduzane.
Manje uFaro makafune indoda ehlakaniphileyo nehlakaniphileyo ayimise phezu kwezwe laseGibhithe.
UFaro makenze lokhu, abeke izinduna phezu kwezwe, athathe okwesihlanu kwezwe laseGibithe ngeminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala.
Mababuthe konke ukudla kweminyaka emihle ezayo, babuthe amabele phansi kwesandla sikaFaro, bagcine ukudla emizini;
Lokho kudla kuyoba ukudla kwezwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala eyoba khona ezweni laseGibhithe; funa izwe libhujiswe yindlala.
Le ndaba yaba yinhle emehlweni kaFaro nasemehlweni ezinceku zakhe zonke.
UFaro wasesithi ezincekwini zakhe: Singamthola yini onjengalo, umuntu onoMoya kaNkulunkulu?
UFaro wayesethi kuJosefa: “Ngokuba uNkulunkulu ukubonisile konke lokhu, akakho ohlakaniphileyo nohlakaniphe njengawe;
Wena uyakuba phezu kwendlu yami, futhi njengezwi lakho bonke abantu bami bayobuswa; esihlalweni sobukhosi kuphela ngizakuba mkhulu kunawe.
UFaro wasesithi kuJosefa: Khangela, ngikumisile phezu kwelizwe lonke leGibhithe.
UFaro wayesekhipha indandatho yakhe esandleni sakhe, wayifaka esandleni sikaJosefa, wamembathisa ilineni elicolekileyo, wafaka iketanga legolide entanyeni yakhe;
Wamkhwelisa enqoleni yesibili ayenayo; bamemeza phambi kwakhe, bathi: Guqani, wambeka umbusi phezu kwelizwe lonke leGibhithe.
UFaro wasesithi kuJosefa: Mina nginguFaro; ngaphandle kwakho kakho ongaphakamisa isandla sakhe loba unyawo lwakhe elizweni lonke leGibhithe.
UFaro waqamba igama likaJosefa ngokuthi, Safnati Phaneya; wamnika u-Asenati indodakazi kaPotifera, umpristi wase-Oni, abe ngumkakhe. UJosefa waphuma, waya ezweni lonke laseGibithe.
UJosefa wayeneminyaka engamashumi amathathu lapho emi phambi kukaFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe. UJosefa wayesesuka kuFaro, walihamba lonke izwe laseGibithe.
Ngeminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala umhlaba wathela ngokugcwala.
Wabutha konke ukudla kweminyaka eyisikhombisa eyayisezweni laseGibithe, wakubeka ukudla emizini; ukudla kwensimu ezungeza yonke imizi wakubeka.
UJosefa wabuthela amabele angangesihlabathi solwandle, amabele, waze wayiyeka isibalo; ngoba lalingelanani.
UJosefa wazalelwa amadodana amabili, ungakafiki unyaka wendlala, amzalela wona u-Asenati indodakazi kaPotifera umpristi wase-Oni.
UJosefa waqamba izibulo ngokuthi uManase, ngokuba wathi uNkulunkulu ungenze ngakhohlwa konke umshikashika wami nayo yonke indlu kababa.
Eyesibili wayiqamba igama lokuthi u-Efrayimi, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wangenza ngazala ezweni losizi lwami.
Yaphela iminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala eyayisezweni laseGibithe.
Iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala yayisiqala ukufika, njengokusho kukaJosefa; kepha ezweni lonke laseGibithe kwakukhona isinkwa.
Izwe lonke laseGibithe labulawa yindlala, abantu bakhalela ukudla kuFaro; uFaro wathi kubo bonke abaseGibithe: “Yanini kuJosefa; yenza lokho akutshela khona.
Indlala yaba phezu komhlaba wonke; uJosefa wavula zonke iziphala, wathengisela amaGibhithe; indlala yaba nzima ezweni laseGibithe.
Amazwe onke afika kuJosefa eGibithe ukuthenga ukolweni; ngoba indlala yayinzima emazweni wonke.
